2607.07716.title: Towards the Explainability of Temporal Graph Networks via Memory Backtracking and Topological Attribution
2607.07716.paper_summary: Temporal graphs are ubiquitous in real-world applications and Temporal Graph Networks (TGNs) have achieved superior predictive accuracy. Understanding which historical events drive model predictions can enhance trustworthiness of TGNs. Existing explanation methods overlook the memory module, the core component that records and updates node histories, leaving the influence of past events unexplored. To address this, we attribute TGNs predictions through the topology attribution tree and memory backtracking tree. The topology attribution tree captures the influence of neighbors and their memory vectors, then the memory backtracking tree quantifies how historical events shape node memory vectors. We apply the LRP in TGNs, ensuring that the total contribution of events equals the logits of model. Finally, top-k selection may be unfaithful due to the nonlinear mapping from logits to probabilities, we design optimization objectives to identify the important events. Experiments on nine temporal graph datasets, spanning node property prediction, link prediction tasks and graph classification tasks, show that our method provides faithful explanations and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/yazhengliu/MemExplainer
2607.07716.paper_summary_zh: 時間圖在現實世界應用中無處不在，而時間圖網絡（TGNs）已達到卓越的預測準確性。了解哪些歷史事件驅動模型預測可以增強TGNs的可信度。現有的解釋方法忽略了記憶模塊，這是記錄和更新節點歷史的核心組件，導致過去事件的影響未被探討。為了解決這個問題，我們通過拓撲歸因樹和記憶回溯樹來歸因TGNs的預測。拓撲歸因樹捕捉鄰居及其記憶向量的影響，然後記憶回溯樹量化歷史事件如何塑造節點記憶向量。我們在TGNs中應用LRP，確保事件的總貢獻等於模型的logits。最後，由於從logits到概率的非線性映射，top-k選擇可能不真實，我們設計優化目標以識別重要事件。在九個時間圖數據集上的實驗，涵蓋節點屬性預測、連結預測任務和圖分類任務，顯示我們的方法提供了可信的解釋並超越了最先進的基準。代碼可在 https://github.com/yazhengliu/MemExplainer 獲得。
